author: FRONTLINE PBS | Official
description: “Dec. 8 was the last day I saw my son.” After Ecuador deployed the military in a sweeping crackdown on surging gang violence and drug-linked crime, families began accusing soldiers of detaining and disappearing innocent people. Among them: 11-year-old Steven Gerald Medina Lajones. Follow Steven’s father, Ronny Medina, and his family as they search for answers about what happened to Steven. PART 1/3
title: Steven's Death: A Family's Fight for Justice 1/3
